summary: Safety Insurance Group Inc. filed an 8-K announcing entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with MAPFRE U.S.A. Corp. and its wholly-owned subsidiary. Under the terms, shareholders will receive $105.00 per share in cash, a premium over the prior unaffected price. The board unanimously approved the deal and recommends stockholders adopt the agreement. The merger is structured as a reverse subsidiary merger with Safety surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of MAPFRE. Unvested restricted stock awards will vest and be cancelled for cash consideration at closing. Regulatory and stockholder approvals are required; the expected closing timeline is uncertain pending these steps.
